title: Hoot
author: Carl Hiaasen
engineRationale: Hoot has no real public figures to depict - it is a small-town Florida story carried by kids, a construction lot and a corporate villain on a speakerphone. Antidote's flat-vector rig (bus, site fence, burrowing owl, golden shovel, microphone) plus kinetic type portrays the whole cast and the paperwork climax without photoreal people.
